items.title: Could Biosimilar Delay Alter The Investment Case For Johnson & Johnson (JNJ)?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson recently secured a preliminary U.S. court injunction delaying Alvotech's AVT05 biosimilar to Simponi and Simponi Aria, and gained FDA accelerated approval for RYBREVANT FASPRO for certain adults with advanced head and neck cancer. These legal and regulatory decisions help Johnson & Johnson protect existing immunology revenue streams while adding a new oncology therapy that supports its effort to offset pressure from aging products. items.title: McDonald’s Joined the Dividend Kings in September, but These 4 Have Been Kings for Decades
items.summary: A 50-year dividend streak proves a company has paid, not that it can keep paying. Five consumer giants now wear the Kings crown, yet each one faces a different threat to its next raise, and one carries a risk the market has already priced in.

items.title: Forget Yield Chasing. These 5 Dividend Stocks Have Raised Payouts Through Every Recession Since the 1970s
items.summary: High yields tend to vanish when recessions hit, but a handful of blue chips kept raising payouts through six downturns. Each faces a real threat to its next raise, and one of them barely covers its dividend with free cash flow.
